description: Lists upcoming and ongoing events with live status pages on Eventstatapp, soonest first. Optionally search by name or location words and limit to a date range. Returns each event's slug, dates, location, current status and links.

from_date.description: Only events still running on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

query.description: Words to look for in the event name or location, e.g. "marathon" or "Richmond". Leave out to list all.

to_date.description: Only events starting on or before this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: list_events
title: List upcoming events
